description: MainActivity.kt defines an Android Activity class that sets up a user interface with voice search capabilities, manages lifecycle events, and constructs a message by utilizing utility classes and external libraries.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity responsible for initializing the UI, handling speech recognition results, permissions, and building a message string from split tokens and string utilities.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, updates a TextView, and sets up the voice search bar.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles activity results, passing speech recognition results to the VoiceSearchBar.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles permission request results, delegating to VoiceSearchBar as needed.

methods.name: buildMessage
methods.description: Creates a message string by splitting some message content, joining tokens, and capitalizing the result.
